desc: Broom-finished concrete driveway with one modest narrow diagonal crack in a clean, controlled repair-preparation setting.
reuse_notes: Use for minor driveway-crack diagnosis, cleaning and repair preparation, concrete-maintenance planning, and drainage-related context. It shows a bounded repairable crack, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for diagnosing movement, slab failure, root pressure, drainage conditions, or permit requirements.
